value.criterion: ac-0001: The implementation guide retains units[].paths and read maps, and packets still carry the assigned unit, its job and observable done conditions; these maps guide work rather than granting write permission.
value.proof: RUN: existing guide, packet, dispatch and skill behavior suites plus source/packed packet smoke.
value.probe: Guide maps and embedded units remain; current work-packet output leads with owned/read paths, job and observable done conditions.

value.criterion: ac-0002: A committed PM change outside mapped PM paths produces file-by-file ownership warnings in the composition receipt and command result, then executes every configured composition check without amendment, justification or an ownership-caused nonzero exit.
value.proof: RUN: lifecycle warning cases and real source/packed Git composition smoke, including an actual failing check retaining its warnings.
value.probe: Shared ownership comparison records scalar file/owning_unit/stage rows; PM writes require no amendment and configured checks still run.

value.criterion: ac-0003: Coder delivery and advancement/import report out-of-map history as the same warning list, including mapped owning unit(s) or an explicit unmapped result, and continue when actual integrity checks pass. No remaining ownership-only check in Builder may refuse.
value.proof: RUN: guide/dispatch/contracts/lifecycle behavior suites, history cases and actual native warning-bearing delivery/import/advance receipts.
value.probe: Guide map policy is advisory; actual dependency proof is based on declared checks/deliveries/snapshots, not path ownership. Warnings survive operational failure envelopes.

value.criterion: ac-0004: A self-serve on-track command works in the coder clone and on the PM integration delta, including selected committed and current work as documented; it returns the same comparison and warnings with exit 0, performs no release/import/approval and does not change source.
value.proof: RUN: builder on-track source/packed real Git smoke for unit history, tracked/untracked selection, PM comparison parity and exit-zero observations.
value.probe: The public on-track surface exists and reuses ownership-service; missing or malformed comparison evidence is reported without mutation or a fabricated clean comparison.

value.criterion: ac-0005: The packet begins with plain-language ownership/read map, job and done conditions before mechanics. Its embedded unit remains available; first-use instructions lead directly to useful work rather than acknowledgement ceremony.
value.proof: RUN: generated work-packet and command/skill tests, source/packed smoke and actual native packet dispatch.
value.probe: Current packet-service prepares map-first useful work; no acknowledgement startup procedure precedes the job.

value.criterion: ac-0006: A coder can run one advisory self-check of expected clone, source commit and packet digest. Mismatch, drift or normal startup metadata yields named observations/warnings and repair advice rather than a work-release gate; there is no required second receipt, second nonce or clock window.
value.proof: RUN: real source/packed self-check for packet bytes, wrong root/digest/commit and startup metadata; native worker correct and deliberately wrong digest observations.
value.probe: One optional local inspection returns warnings without receipt writes, native sends or a release gate. A wrong digest did not stop the native worker.

value.criterion: ac-0007: Dispatch, delivery, import, advance and review no longer depend on pre-work/post-release acknowledgement receipt IDs, phase nonces, canary challenge or plus/minus-five-second timing to authorize work; old records remain readable and need no replay or fabricated upgrade.
value.proof: RUN: delivery/import/advance regressions without acknowledgement records, legacy-schema preservation smoke and actual native dispatch/delivery.
value.probe: Current delivery consumers no longer demand ack/release nonces, canary or clock-window evidence; historical schema readers remain explicit.

value.criterion: ac-0008: At import, wrong tree/commit lineage, forged or mismatched delivery/packet evidence, duplicate peer and rewritten baseline still refuse before an incorrect composition mutation. Each integrity refusal names the actual cause and corrective next step; legitimate descendant source and evidence-only commits retain their supported path.
value.proof: RUN: existing and extended workspace/dispatch/contracts/lifecycle integrity cases plus a real native mismatched-packet import refusing before HEAD mutation.
value.probe: Wrong evidence, duplicate peer, tree/branch/source/baseline integrity remain failures; valid artifact ancestors of later worker evidence commits are accepted.

value.criterion: ac-0009: Reviewers receive the recorded ownership warning list alongside the exact composed bytes; warnings do not veto review or advancement by themselves, and the PM cannot approve its own artifact as the independent reviewer.
value.proof: RUN: independent-review integrity cases and actual native warning-bearing composition review and advancement.
value.probe: The independent native reviewer approved the exact artifact after correcting its own inconsistent disposition; the rejected original review remains preserved.

value.criterion: ac-000a: The supported runtime, help, schemas, docs, skills and examples contain no amendment requirement or competing two-receipt startup path. PR #200 remains closed without merge; no alias or legacy gate revives its declaration design.
value.proof: RUN: full-scope checks including docs/flows/doctrine drift, command/skill tests and a fresh offline packed consumer smoke.
value.probe: Current help/docs/skills/schemas expose warning guidance and on-track/self-check without a live ack/amend path. PR #200 remains closed without merge.

value.criterion: ac-000b: A real CLI/Git consumer scenario demonstrates map-first dispatch, one optional advisory self-check, cross-map coder/PM edits, warning-preserving import/composition, independent review and receipt-only archival re-observation; contrasting integrity failures still refuse and existing historical evidence remains unmodified.
value.proof: RUN: source/packed CLI/Git smoke plus the separately retained actual native operational scenario, including warning-preserving archive re-observation and independent durable evidence verification.
value.probe: Actual native PM, two workers and independent reviewer completed the operational pipeline using pinned private runtimes after two supported product repairs. Strict run compliance is false; hook/provider/replay limits and original failures remain explicit in lg-0004.
